mapping_note: Direct mappings cover the save request and successful setup needed to test restore failure (4.19, 4.23), the restore request/result and initiation callbacks needed to reach the failure service (4.27-4.30), the Federate Reported Failure During Save reason returned through Federation Not Saved (4.23), and the Federate Reported Failure During Restore reason returned through Federation Not Restored (4.33). Callback disable/enable suppression and release, callback-model-specific servicing, and cleanup are supplemental public-API checks; no callback-control-specific normative mapping is claimed. This does not test persistence format or application-state serialization.
notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard federation save and restore failure callbacks. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of federation save and restore failure callbacks, successful save setup needed for a restore failure, exact failure reasons, callback-model servicing, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
